$comment: Patterns end in (?!\n)$ because Python re, which jsonschema uses, lets $ match before a final newline and ECMA-262 does not; the lookahead keeps both engines in agreement.
title: memory-bank.yaml
description: Configuration for one Bank, read from memory-bank.yaml at the Bank root.

schema.description: Set to 1, the config schema version.

name.description: Name the Bank. It labels this Bank's Records in multi-Bank results.

facet_prefixes.description: List every Facet prefix this Bank allows, such as service or domain. Records may use only these.

folders.description: Map a memory type to its folder, relative to the Bank root. Defaults: Decision _memory/decisions, PolicyRule _memory/policy-rules, Exception _memory/exceptions, Context _memory/context.

consumers.description: Map a Consumer repo's git remote, as org/repo, to the Facets its agents read. A subgroup repo's key keeps every org segment, as in grp/sub/repo.

heading_aliases.description: Map a canonical body heading (Context, Decision, Consequences, Status) to the other headings that count as it.

doctor.description: Override the thresholds ltm doctor reports against. Omit a key to keep its default.

stale_confirmed_days.description: Report a Record whose last_confirmed is older than this many days.

proposal_age_days.description: Report a Proposal older than this many days.

max_chain_length.description: Report a Supersession chain longer than this many Records.

orphan_days.description: Report a Record with no relationships once it is older than this many days.

near_duplicate_threshold.description: Report two accepted Records as near-duplicates when a ranked recall backend scores them above this.

recall.description: The ranked backend that ltm doctor's near-duplicate check and ltm query --text search through. See docs/doctor.md and docs/retrieval-model.md.

query.description: Settings for ltm query: how it ranks --text through recall: (see Stage 0 in docs/retrieval-model.md) and whether Org-wide Records match a Facet query.

min_score.description: Drop a Record that the recall backend scores below this. Required when recall.mode is vector, since cosine scores have no natural cutoff; optional under search.

org_wide.description: Set to exclude to keep Org-wide Records, those with no applies_to, out of every Facet query, whether its Facets come from --facet or from the Bank's consumers map. An Org-wide Record still matches key=value filters, --text, and any query with no Facet. Default include.

subject.description: Reserved. Accepted with any value, and v1 ignores it.

then.$comment: Vector mode scores on a cosine scale, so near_duplicate_threshold's search default doesn't apply and ltm query has no sensible cutoff to assume: the Bank must set both. loadRecall in src/core/qmd.ts enforces the threshold for ltm doctor, and ltm query's loader enforces min_score. Keep this the schema's only if/then; checkConfig in src/core/validate.ts relies on it.

facet.description: A Facet written as <prefix>:<value>, with a lowercase prefix.
